title: 太空侵略者
creator: Taito
note: 外星人逐行下压的节奏与心跳音效，是整个射击游戏类型的第一块奠基石。
noteEn: The descending alien march and heartbeat blips laid the foundation of the entire shooting genre.

title: R 型战机
creator: Irem
note: 蓄力波动炮与可分离的强力装甲，把卷轴射击的战术深度推上前无古人的高度。
noteEn: A chargeable wave cannon and detachable Force pod pushed the side-scrolling shooter's tactical depth to new heights.

title: 德军总部 3D
creator: id Software
note: 用射线投射技术在 486 上画出可以走进去的城堡，第一人称射击的起点。
noteEn: Ray-casting drew walkable castle corridors on a 486 — the birthplace of the first-person shooter.

title: 毁灭战士
creator: id Software
note: 联网死亡竞赛的鼻祖，也是第一代让玩家半夜拔掉电话线只为多杀一局的游戏。
noteEn: The pioneer of networked deathmatch and the first game to make players yank the phone line at 2am.

title: 雷神之锤
creator: id Software
note: 真正的 3D 引擎让你第一次能低头看见自己的脚，也为竞技 FPS 立下准绳。
noteEn: True 3D let you look down at your own feet and set the benchmark for competitive FPS.

title: 黄金眼 007
creator: Rare
note: 用一支 N64 手柄做出爆头、潜行与四人分屏，主机 FPS 从此不再只是 PC 的附庸。
noteEn: Headshots, stealth and four-player split-screen on one N64 pad — the console FPS finally came of age.

title: 半条命
creator: Valve
note: 用脚本事件串起无缝叙事，把 FPS 从「清空房间继续走」变成一场发生在你身上的故事。
noteEn: Seamless scripted storytelling turned the FPS from room-clearing into a story that happens to you.

title: 完美黑暗
creator: Rare
note: 《黄金眼》的精神续作，把仿生机器人队友与复杂枪械改造塞进一张 N64 卡带。
noteEn: GoldenEye's spiritual sequel packed simulant bots and a deep weapon-lab into one N64 cart.

title: 反恐精英
creator: Valve
note: 从《半条命》模组变成职业电竞的地基，一把 AWP 的命准能改写整局经济。
noteEn: A Half-Life mod that became pro esports' bedrock — one AWP round can flip an entire economy.

title: 光环：战斗进化
creator: Bungie
note: 双武器、一颗雷与能量护盾的设计，让主机射击终于追上鼠标精度，也成就了 Xbox 首发。
noteEn: Two weapons, a grenade and a shield — the design that let console shooters finally rival the mouse.

title: 银河战士 Prime
creator: Retro Studios
note: 第一人称视角下的银河恶魔城，扫描仪让每一个敌人与遗迹都变成可读的文本。
noteEn: A Metroidvania seen through a visor — the scan visor turns every foe and ruin into readable text.

title: 光环 2
creator: Bungie
note: 双持武器与士官长/神风烈士双线叙事，也是 Xbox Live 联机体验的里程碑。
noteEn: Dual wielding and a two-sided narrative — the benchmark that defined Xbox Live multiplayer.

title: 半条命 2
creator: Valve
note: Source 引擎的物理谜题与重力枪，让场景里每一件杂物都能成为武器。
noteEn: The Source engine's physics puzzles and gravity gun turned every loose object into a weapon.

title: 恐惧
creator: Monolith Productions
note: 至今少有人及的敌人 AI——他们会包抄、会压制、会在走廊里设伏等你。
noteEn: Enemy AI few games have matched — they flank, suppress and ambush you in the hallways.

title: 孤岛危机
creator: Crytek
note: 纳米服的隐身与力量模式、可摧毁的植被，成了当年「你的电脑跑得动吗」的终极拷问。
noteEn: Nanosuit stealth, strength modes and destructible jungle — the ultimate 'can your PC run it?' benchmark.

title: 使命召唤 4：现代战争
creator: Infinity Ward
note: 把战场从二战拉回现代，AC-130 炮火支援与核爆序章把脚本演出推到电影级。
noteEn: Modern warfare, AC-130 gunship strikes and a nuke sequence that pushed scripted set-pieces to cinema.

title: 生化奇兵
creator: Irrational Games
note: 水下乌托邦 Rapture 用一句「Would you kindly?」当众拷问玩家的自由意志。
noteEn: The underwater utopia of Rapture interrogates free will with one phrase: 'Would you kindly?'

title: 军团要塞 2
creator: Valve
note: 九个职业、漫画画风与每年一度的更新季，为「喜剧 FPS」立下了范本。
noteEn: Nine classes, a comic-book look and yearly updates — the template for the comedy FPS.

title: 潜行者：切尔诺贝利的阴影
creator: GSC Game World
note: 把切尔诺贝利禁区做成 A-Life 生态模拟的开放世界，潮湿、残酷又莫名迷人。
noteEn: The Zone as a living A-Life ecosystem — damp, brutal and strangely magnetic.

title: 光环 3
creator: Bungie
note: 士官长三部曲的收束，锻造模式与电影回放让玩家亲手制作自己的传奇。
noteEn: The Master Chief trilogy's finale — Forge maps and film replays let players author their own legend.

title: 杀戮地带 2
creator: Guerrilla Games
note: 沉重的手感与暴烈的粒子效果，把「战争的重量」压进每一次扣扳机。
noteEn: Weighty gunplay and ferocious particle effects put the sheer weight of war behind every trigger pull.

title: 求生之路 2
creator: Valve
note: AI 导演会偷看你的血量临时调整尸潮，让每一次通关都像第一次那么紧张。
noteEn: The AI Director peeks at your health and reshuffles the horde, so no run ever plays the same.

title: 子弹风暴
creator: People Can Fly
note: 用鞭子把敌人甩进仙人掌再补一记飞踢，把「处刑分」做成了一套作秀系统。
noteEn: Whip enemies into cacti then kick them mid-air — a skill-shot scoring system built for showboating.

title: 特殊行动：一线生机
creator: Yager Development
note: 表面是掩体射击，内里是对「战争英雄叙事」的反战控诉，白磷弹一幕令人难忘。
noteEn: A cover shooter that indicts war-hero narratives — the white-phosphorus scene is unforgettable.

title: 孤岛惊魂 3
creator: Ubisoft Montreal
note: 反派 Vaas 疯癫的独白，让「割据孤岛」的沙盒第一次有了会咬人的反派。
noteEn: Vaas's unhinged monologue gave the island sandbox its first genuinely menacing villain.

title: 斯普拉遁
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 用墨水涂地代替爆头计数，证明射击游戏不必总是灰暗与血腥的。
noteEn: Inking turf instead of counting headshots — proof that a shooter doesn't have to be grim.

title: 泰坦陨落 2
creator: Respawn Entertainment
note: 单机关卡「Effect and Cause」把双时间线玩出花，是近十年最被低估的 FPS 战役之一。
noteEn: The time-shift level 'Effect and Cause' is one of the decade's most underrated FPS campaigns.

title: 守望先锋
creator: Blizzard Entertainment
note: 把 MOBA 的职责分工塞进 6v6 射击，用英雄与高饱和配色重构了团队对抗。
noteEn: MOBA-style roles distilled into 6v6 shooting, reimagining team combat around heroes and color.

title: 毁灭战士 2016
creator: id Software
note: 用处决回血取代掩体，把「射爆一切」本身做成了一套优雅自洽的循环。
noteEn: Glory kills replace cover — a perfectly elegant loop built entirely around ripping demons apart.

title: 死亡回归
creator: Housemarque
note: 把 Roguelike 死亡循环与第三人称弹幕枪战嫁接，故障美学与身体恐怖同行。
noteEn: A roguelike death-loop fused with third-person bullet-hell — glitch aesthetic meets body horror.

title: 文明
creator: MicroProse
note: 从石器时代到星际航行的一声「再来一回合」，4X 策略的万恶之源。
noteEn: From stone age to spaceflight — the 'one more turn' origin of all 4X strategy.

title: 沙丘 II
en: Dune II: The Building of a Dynasty
creator: Westwood Studios
note: 鼠标框选、采矿造兵、雷达小地图——现代 RTS 的语法几乎都诞生于此。
noteEn: Mouse selection, harvester economy and a radar map — the grammar of the modern RTS was written here.

title: 命令与征服
creator: Westwood Studios
note: 真人过场与 GDI/Nod 的阵营对抗，让 RTS 第一次有了电影般的号召力。
noteEn: Live-action cutscenes and GDI-vs-Nod rivalry gave the RTS its first real star power.

title: 魔兽争霸 2：黑暗之潮
creator: Blizzard Entertainment
note: 海陆空三军与更顺滑的操作，确立了 Blizzard「易上手、难精通」的 RTS 路线。
noteEn: Naval, land and air forces with slick controls set Blizzard's easy-to-learn, hard-to-master RTS course.

title: 横扫千军
creator: Cavedog Entertainment
note: 数千单位同屏与全自动建造经济，把 RTS 的规模感整整抬高了一个量级。
noteEn: Thousands of units on screen and a self-building economy scaled the RTS up a full order of magnitude.

title: 最终幻想战略版
creator: Square
note: 伊瓦利斯大陆的政治权谋与转职系统，是日式战棋叙事的一座珠峰。
noteEn: Ivalice's political intrigue and job system — the Everest of Japanese tactical RPGs.

title: 星际争霸
creator: Blizzard Entertainment
note: 三个种族在平衡性上互相咬合，直接养大了韩国的电竞产业。
noteEn: Three races locked in exquisite balance — the game that built South Korea's esports industry.

title: 帝国时代 2：国王时代
en: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings
creator: Ensemble Studios
note: 「伐伐伐伐木工」的钟声还在回响，它的战役手册读起来像半部中世纪史。
noteEn: Those woodcutter shouts still echo — its campaigns read like half a medieval history textbook.

title: 半人马座阿尔法星
creator: Firaxis Games
note: 把《文明》搬上外星球，七个阵营的剧情文本读起来像哲学宣言。
noteEn: Civilization on a hostile planet — seven factions whose texts read like philosophical manifestos.

title: 命令与征服：红色警戒 2
creator: Westwood Pacific
note: 磁暴坦克与尤里的搞怪过场，把冷战梗做成了一部 B 级片狂欢。
noteEn: Tesla tanks and Yuri's camp cutscenes — the Cold War as an unhinged B-movie.

title: 高级战争
creator: Intelligent Systems
note: 像素小人、CO 技能与兵种相克压缩进一张 GBA 卡带，是回合制策略的教科书。
noteEn: Pixel troops, CO powers and a rock-paper-scissors counter system in a GBA cart — turn-based tactics distilled.

title: 魔兽争霸 3：混乱之治
creator: Blizzard Entertainment
note: 英雄单位与经验值让 RTS 有了 RPG 的心跳，也顺手埋下了 Dota 的种子。
noteEn: Hero units and XP gave the RTS an RPG heartbeat — and quietly planted the seed of Dota.

title: 文明 4
creator: Firaxis Games
note: 宗教、公民制度与伦纳德·尼莫伊配音的科技树，是系列口碑的巅峰。
noteEn: Religion, civics and Leonard Nimoy-narrated tech quotes — the series' critical peak.

title: 英雄连
creator: Relic Entertainment
note: 掩体机制与完全可摧毁的地形，让二战战术第一次有了真正的「地形感」。
noteEn: Cover mechanics and fully destructible terrain gave WWII tactics real spatial depth.

title: 最高指挥官
creator: Gas Powered Games
note: 无限拉近又无限拉远的战略视图，让绵延数百公里的战场尽收一屏。
noteEn: Zoom from a single tank to a continent-wide battlefield — RTS scale reinvented.

title: 文明 5
creator: Firaxis Games
note: 六边形格与「一单位一格」的改动，彻底重写了系列的地图逻辑。
noteEn: Hex tiles and one-unit-per-tile reinvented the series' map logic from the ground up.

title: 全面战争：幕府将军 2
creator: Creative Assembly
note: 回合制治国与实时合战的无缝结合，是战国题材策略的巅峰答卷。
noteEn: Turn-based realm management fused with real-time battles — the definitive Sengoku strategy game.

title: 十字军之王 2
creator: Paradox Development Studio
note: 你不是在统治国家，而是在扮演一个会恋爱、会暗杀、也会死于感冒的贵族。
noteEn: You don't rule a nation — you play a noble who falls in love, plots murder and dies of a cold.

title: XCOM：未知敌人
creator: Firaxis Games
note: 把 95% 命中率打空的绝望与基地经营绑定，让每一次失败都刻骨铭心。
noteEn: Binds the despair of a 95% shot that misses to base management — every loss cuts deep.

title: 欧陆风云 4
creator: Paradox Development Studio
note: 从 1444 到 1821 的四百年代理棋，贸易、宗教与王朝阴谋织成一张巨网。
noteEn: Four hundred years of grand strategy from 1444 — trade, religion and dynastic intrigue in one web.

title: 刀塔 2
creator: Valve
note: 一个英雄只给四个技能，减法设计却孕育出全世界最深的竞技体系之一。
noteEn: One hero, four buttons — an economy of design that bred one of the deepest competitive scenes on Earth.

title: 钢铁雄心 4
creator: Paradox Development Studio
note: 从「柏林之路」国策树到自绘装甲师徽章，是全二战史的军宅狂欢。
noteEn: From the Berlin Express focus tree to custom tank-division emblems — a full-warfare military history sandbox.

title: 群星
creator: Paradox Development Studio
note: 把《文明》的探索搬进银河系，虫子、机器与灵能文明在同一片星海崛起。
noteEn: Civilization-style exploration scaled to the galaxy, where bugs, bots and psionics all rise.

title: 全面战争：战锤 2
creator: Creative Assembly
note: 魔法、巨兽与漩涡仪式战，把中古战锤的疯狂搬上宏大战役地图。
noteEn: Magic, monsters and vortex ritual battles bring the Warhammer Old World's madness to the campaign map.

title: 冰汽时代
creator: 11 bit studios
note: 当世界只剩零下 150 度，你会签下童工法案，还是看着整座城市冻死？
noteEn: When the world freezes to -150°C, do you sign the child-labor law or watch the city die?

title: 陷阵之志
creator: Subset Games
note: 把战棋压缩成 8x8 格与五回合，敌人会预报行动，胜利全靠推、拉、挤。
noteEn: Turn-based tactics shrunk to an 8x8 grid where enemies telegraph every move — victory by shove and push.

title: 杀戮尖塔
creator: Mega Crit Games
note: 卡牌构建 × Roguelike 的祖师爷，每一次抓牌都是一场与随机性的谈判。
noteEn: The deckbuilder-roguelike progenitor — every card pick is a negotiation with randomness.

title: 火焰之纹章：风花雪月
creator: Intelligent Systems
note: 学院日常与五年后战场的双时段结构，让每场战斗都背负着人情债。
noteEn: Monastery life and a five-year jump make every battle carry the weight of old bonds.

title: 帝国时代 4
creator: Relic Entertainment
note: 纪录片式战役与全新文明机制，稳稳接住了老玩家二十年的期待。
noteEn: Documentary-style campaigns and fresh civ mechanics carry two decades of pent-up expectations.

title: 漫威暗夜之子
creator: Firaxis Games
note: XCOM 团队的卡牌战棋让漫威角色同台斗法，可惜栽在了发行档期上。
noteEn: XCOM's card-based tactics meet Marvel's roster — a gem that fell victim to release timing.

title: 模拟城市
creator: Maxis
note: 没有输赢、只有规划的「软件玩具」，城市模拟类型的起点。
noteEn: A software toy with no win state — only planning — where the city-builder began.

title: 模拟城市 2000
creator: Maxis
note: 地下管线、教育预算与通勤模型，让治理一座城市第一次如此令人着迷。
noteEn: Underground pipes, education budgets and commute models made running a city genuinely addictive.

title: 运输大亨豪华版
creator: Chris Sawyer
note: 用铁路网把整片大陆盘活，它的信号灯与经济模型至今仍被开源社区供养。
noteEn: A rail empire that breathes life into a continent — its signals and economy still thrive in open source.

title: 过山车大亨
creator: Chris Sawyer
note: 手绘像素加硬核经营，让「把游客甩晕再收门票」成了快乐源泉。
noteEn: Hand-drawn pixels and hardcore economics — spinning guests dizzy and charging them for it.

title: 模拟人生
creator: Maxis
note: 用几根「需求条」模拟日常琐碎，却让全世界玩家对虚拟小人产生真实同理心。
noteEn: Daily needs rendered as little bars — yet players worldwide felt real empathy for those pixels.

title: 模拟人生 2
creator: Maxis
note: 加入生命周期与遗传系统，小人第一次会长大、老去并留下后代。
noteEn: Lifespans, genetics and generations — for the first time your sims aged, died and left heirs.

title: 微软模拟飞行 X
creator: Aces Game Studio
note: 一度是许多人心中的「飞行教科书」，也是装机党偷偷拿来测显卡的常客。
noteEn: For years a flight textbook, and the benchmark every PC builder secretly ran to test their GPU.

title: 孢子
creator: Maxis
note: 从单细胞到星际文明的五阶段进化，把上帝视角玩成了物种养成。
noteEn: Five stages from single cell to spacefaring civilization — god games as species husbandry.

title: 欧洲卡车模拟 2
creator: SCS Software
note: 把「开卡车送货」做成养老型治愈，电台配乐让每一公里都变成享受。
noteEn: Trucking as a cozy retirement sim — radio, autobahn and endless delivery zen.

title: 坎巴拉太空计划
creator: Squad
note: 用真实的轨道力学把火箭送上天的沙盒，是一代人的航天物理启蒙。
noteEn: Real orbital mechanics in a rocket sandbox — the aerospace physics primer a generation deserved.

title: 城市：天际线
creator: Colossal Order
note: 交通建模细致到每一条匝道，是《模拟城市》玩家集体流亡后的应许之地。
noteEn: Traffic modeled down to every off-ramp — the promised land SimCity players fled to.

title: 星露谷物语
creator: ConcernedApe
note: 一个人写出的种田情书，把农场、矿洞与小镇社交织成治愈循环。
noteEn: One developer's love letter to farming — crops, caves and small-town bonds in a healing loop.

title: 过山车之星
creator: Frontier Developments
note: 造景自由度堪比专业建模软件，让「主题乐园设计师」成了热门虚拟职业。
noteEn: Scenery tools rivaling pro modeling software — a virtual career for theme-park designers.

title: 环世界
creator: Ludeon Studios
note: AI 讲故事机：一场疯狗袭击就能毁掉三年的殖民地，然后变成传奇。
noteEn: An AI storyteller — one mad-dog raid can topple a three-year colony, then become legend.

title: 双点医院
creator: Two Point Studios
note: 《主题医院》的精神续作，用英式冷幽默处理「头晕病」与光怪陆离的疑难杂症。
noteEn: Theme Hospital's spiritual heir, treating lightheadedness and other absurd ailments with British wit.

title: 动物园之星
creator: Frontier Developments
note: 每只动物都带遗传与行为模型，经营之下更像一座活的生态博物馆。
noteEn: Every animal has genetics and behavior — a living museum beneath the management game.

title: 集合啦！动物森友会
creator: Nintendo EPD
note: 一座荒岛在真实时间里缓缓成形，成为疫情隔离期千万人的情感缓冲垫。
noteEn: An island shaping itself in real time — the emotional cushion millions needed during lockdown.

title: 微软模拟飞行
creator: Asobo Studio
note: 卫星测绘让整个地球都可飞，机外视角里的云海是工程与视觉的双重奇观。
noteEn: The whole planet flyable via satellite data — cloudscapes that are a feat of engineering and art.

title: 异星工厂
creator: Wube Software
note: 传送带与机械臂的自动化诗歌，「再优化一条产线就睡」是最甜蜜的时间黑洞。
noteEn: An automated symphony of belts and inserters — the time-sink that outgrew its own factory.

title: 矮人要塞
creator: Bay 12 Games
note: 用字符界面模拟一整座要塞的生态与传说，是游戏史上最深的模拟之一。
noteEn: A fortress's ecology and legends simulated in ASCII — among the deepest simulations ever made.

title: 极速赛车
creator: Namco
note: 伪 3D 道路与排位赛机制，确立了整个竞速游戏类型的基本语法。
noteEn: Pseudo-3D roads and qualifying rounds fixed the basic grammar of the racing game.

title: 狂飙赛车
creator: Sega AM2
note: 选择岔路的磁带公路、夕阳配色与兜风气氛，定义了「开着车去度假」的浪漫。
noteEn: Branching roads, a convertible and sunset palettes defined the romance of a Sunday drive.

title: 零式赛车
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: Mode 7 伪 3D 的贴地飞行，用 15 秒一圈的极限速度定义了「快」。
noteEn: Mode 7 pseudo-3D flight 15 seconds a lap — the game that defined raw velocity.

title: 超级马力欧赛车
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: 香蕉皮与红龟壳的四人对战，让「竞速」从此有了合家欢的入口。
noteEn: Banana-slip four-player chaos — the party game hiding inside a racer.

title: 山脊赛车
creator: Namco
note: 首款把漂移当成艺术品的街机赛车，也是 PlayStation 的首发护航大作。
noteEn: The arcade racer that made drifting an art — and a PlayStation launch icon.

title: 戴托纳美国
creator: Sega AM2
note: 「Rolling start!」的欢呼与三圈环道，是 Sega Model 2 基板时代最响亮的引擎声。
noteEn: The 'Rolling Start!' roar and tri-oval thrash — the loudest engine on Sega's Model 2 board.

title: 反重力赛车
creator: Psygnosis
note: 把锐舞文化与电子乐灌进反重力赛车，成为电玩潮流与时尚的标志。
noteEn: Anti-gravity racing fused with rave culture and electronic soundtracks — gaming's style icon.

title: 跑车浪漫旅
creator: Polyphony Digital
note: 数百辆真实授权车与驾照考试，把「拟真驾驶」变成一项值得练习的技能。
noteEn: Hundreds of licensed cars and a license test that turned realistic driving into a skill worth mastering.

title: 零式赛车 GX
creator: Amusement Vision
note: 赛博朋克街机风格与地狱级难度，被公认为史上最硬核的高速赛车之一。
noteEn: Cyberpunk arcade style and brutal difficulty — arguably the hardest high-speed racer ever made.

title: 极品飞车：地下狂飙
creator: EA Black Box
note: 霓虹街灯、改装文化与氮气加速，让午夜街头赛成为一代人的向往。
noteEn: Neon streets, tuning culture and nitrous boosts — midnight street racing as a generation's fantasy.

title: 横冲直撞 3
creator: Criterion Games
note: 把「撞毁对手」做成得分核心，每一次追尾都配有慢动作回放。
noteEn: Crashes as the scoring system — every takedown rewarded with a slow-motion replay.

title: 极品飞车：最高通缉
creator: EA Black Box
note: 警匪追逐与黑名单 15 人，把「被通缉」做成了最刺激的猫鼠游戏。
noteEn: Police chases and a Blacklist of 15 — being hunted made into the most thrilling cat-and-mouse.

title: 赛道狂飙：国家永恒
creator: Nadeo
note: 免费联机的花样赛道编辑器，让「撞墙也能夺冠」的欢乐成了电竞赛事。
noteEn: Free-to-play stunt racing with a track editor — where crashing into a wall can still win the race.

title: 极限竞速：地平线
creator: Playground Games
note: 把科罗拉多州做成音乐节般的开放世界，竞速第一次有了「假期感」。
noteEn: Colorado as an open-world music festival — the first racer that felt like a road trip.

title: 神力科莎
creator: Kunos Simulazioni
note: 面向硬核玩家的物理引擎与激光扫描赛道，靠 MOD 生态长盛不衰。
noteEn: A physics engine built for hardcore sim racers — laser-scanned tracks and mods keep it alive.

title: 尘埃拉力赛 2.0
creator: Codemasters
note: 领航员口播与动态路面损毁，把拉力赛的紧张感压进每一次刹车。
noteEn: Co-driver calls and a dynamic surface model deliver rally tension in every braking zone.

title: 极限竞速：地平线 5
creator: Playground Games
note: 墨西哥的火山、雨林与沙漠同屏驰骋，是开放世界赛车目前的天花板。
noteEn: Volcano, jungle and desert in one Mexican map — the current ceiling of open-world racing.
